verdict.rationale: Hightouch ships AI features (AI Decisioning, a built-in agent, an MCP server, and generative ad creative), so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair question. The evidence pack contains no AI-training policy, opt-out control, or contractual no-training commitment. The community note that data stays in the customer's warehouse speaks to storage architecture, not to model training, so it does not establish this capability.
